phrases.O relatório Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP) mede: The Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP) report measures the change in the number of people employed in the US, excluding farmworkers, government employees, domestic workers, and NGO employees.
phrases.Dados acima do esperado indicam economia: Better-than-expected data indicates a strong economy, which could lead the Fed to maintain or increase interest rates. Lower-than-expected data suggests an economic slowdown, increasing the chances of interest cuts.
phrases.NFP forte geralmente pressiona cripto ne: Strong NFP generally pressures crypto negatively in the short term (expectation of high interest rates). Weak NFP could boost crypto as alternative to dollar.
phrases.O Consumer Price Index (CPI) mede a vari: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) measures the average variation in prices paid by consumers for a basket of goods and services. It is the main indicator of inflation in the USA.
phrases.Inflação acima do esperado aumenta a pro: Higher-than-expected inflation increases the likelihood of high interest rates for longer. Falling inflation leaves room for interest rate cuts and stimulates risky assets.
phrases.Alta inflação historicamente beneficia B: High inflation historically benefits Bitcoin as a hedge. However, if inflation forces high interest rates, there will be short-term negative pressure on crypto.
phrases.O Producer Price Index (PPI) mede a vari: The Producer Price Index (PPI) measures the average variation in prices received by domestic producers for their production. It is a leading indicator of consumer inflation.
phrases.PPI é visto como preview do CPI. Aumento: PPI is seen as a preview of the CPI. A strong increase in the PPI indicates that inflation may rise, affecting the Fed's interest rate decisions.
phrases.Impacto similar ao CPI, mas geralmente m: Similar impact to CPI, but generally more moderate. It serves as a warning sign for future movements in crypto.
phrases.O relatório de Retail Sales mede o valor: The Retail Sales report measures the total value of retail sales in the US. It is a key indicator of consumer and economic health.
phrases.Vendas fortes indicam economia resilient: Strong sales indicate a resilient economy, which could prolong the high interest cycle. Weak sales suggest slowdown and possible recession.
phrases.Dados de varejo fortes geralmente são be: Strong retail data is generally bearish for crypto (keeps interest high). Weak data could be bullish if it indicates upcoming interest rate cuts.
phrases.A reunião do Federal Open Market Committ: The meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) decides the US base interest rate. The Fed Chair's statement and briefing provide guidance on future monetary policy.
phrases.É o evento mais importante para mercados: It is the most important event for financial markets. Changes in the rate or tone of the statement can cause extreme movements across assets.
phrases.Cortes de juros são extremamente bullish: Rate cuts are extremely bullish for crypto. Raises or hawkish tone are bearish. Volatility is maximum during and after the announcement.
phrases.O Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) mede o val: Gross Domestic Product (GDP) measures the total value of goods and services produced in the economy. Quarterly data is crucial for assessing the pace of economic growth.
phrases.PIB forte sugere economia saudável, mas: Strong GDP suggests a healthy economy, but may indicate inflationary pressure. Weak GDP raises recession concerns but could accelerate interest rate cuts.
phrases.PIB muito forte pode ser bearish (juros: Very strong GDP can be bearish (high interest rates). GDP in moderate deceleration could be bullish if expectations of cuts accelerate.
phrases.O ISM Services Index mede a atividade no: The ISM Services Index measures activity in the services sector, which represents more than 70% of the American economy. Reading above 50 indicates expansion.
phrases.Setor de serviços forte mantém inflação: Strong services sector maintains high inflation (especially wages). Slowdown may indicate economy cooling down.
phrases.Impacto moderado. ISM muito forte é leve: Moderate impact. Very strong ISM is slightly bearish for crypto. Weak ISM may be slightly bullish.
phrases.O Banco Central Europeu (BCE) decide a t: The European Central Bank (ECB) decides the interest rate for the Eurozone. European monetary policy affects global markets and the EUR/USD relationship.
phrases.Divergência entre políticas do Fed e BCE: Divergence between Fed and ECB policies affects exchange rates. Dovish ECB strengthens dollar. Hawkish ECB weakens dollar.
phrases.Impacto indireto via dólar. BCE dovish (: Indirect impact via dollars. Dovish ECB (strong dollar) could pressure crypto. Hawkish ECB (weak dollar) could benefit crypto.
phrases.Dados econômicos importantes que podem a: Important economic data that can affect monetary policy and financial markets.
phrases.O impacto em criptomoedas depende de com: The impact on cryptocurrencies depends on how the market interprets the data in relation to expectations.
phrases.Não foi possível carregar o calendário e: Unable to load the economic calendar. Please try again later.
phrases.O S&P 500 é um índice que mede o desempe: S&P 500 is an index that measures the performance of the 500 largest publicly traded companies in the United States. It is considered the main benchmark for the American stock market and an indicator of the health of the economy.
phrases.Valores em alta indicam otimismo no merc: Rising values indicate optimism in the market (risk-on). Significant drops (>2%) may indicate risk aversion. The index above historic highs suggests investor confidence.
phrases.Alta correlação com Bitcoin em 2024-2025: High correlation with Bitcoin in 2024-2025. Strong S&P generally favors crypto. Sudden drops in the S&P often drag crypto along, especially during sell-offs.
phrases.Monitore futuros do S&P pré-mercado (ES): Monitor S&P pre-market (ES) futures. Positive openings in the US often boost crypto. Gap downs can be a buying opportunity if the market recovers.
phrases.O Dollar Index (DXY) mede a força do dól: The Dollar Index (DXY) measures the strength of the US dollar against a basket of 6 major currencies (EUR, JPY, GBP, CAD, SEK, CHF). The Euro represents 57.6% of the index's weight.
phrases.DXY subindo = dólar fortalecendo. DXY >: DXY rising = dollar strengthening. DXY > 105 indicates a very strong dollar. DXY < 100 indicates dollar weakness. Movements of 1% are significant.
phrases.Correlação INVERSA com Bitcoin. Dólar fo: INVERSE correlation with Bitcoin. Strong dollar (DXY high) generally pressures crypto negatively. Weak dollar (DXY falling) is historically bullish for BTC.
phrases.Use DXY como confirmação. Se BTC está su: Use DXY as confirmation. If BTC is rising and DXY is falling, the uptrend has more strength. Divergences (BTC rising with DXY strong) deserve caution.
phrases.O VIX, conhecido como \"Índice do Medo\": The VIX, known as the "Fear Index", measures the expected volatility of S&P 500 over the next 30 days based on options. It is calculated by the CBOE.
phrases.25: Alto medo no mercado. VIX > 40: Pâni: 25: High fear in the market. VIX > 40: Extreme panic (rare).
phrases.VIX alto geralmente causa quedas em crip: VIX high usually causes declines in crypto (flight to safety). Extreme spikes in VIX often mark market bottoms. VIX too low may precede corrections.
phrases.VIX acima de 30 historicamente são boas: VIX above 30 are historically good long-term buying opportunities. Do not buy when VIX is very low (<13) - it may indicate a market top.
phrases.O ouro é um ativo de reserva de valor mi: Gold is an ancient store of value asset. The spot price is quoted in dollars per troy ounce. It is considered a safe haven in times of economic uncertainty.
phrases.Ouro subindo + mercados caindo = flight: Gold rising + markets falling = flight to safety. Gold rising with strong markets = concern about inflation. Gold above $2500 indicates high demand for protection.
phrases.Bitcoin é frequentemente chamado de \"ou: Bitcoin is often called "digital gold". Both can rise together in scenarios of dollar devaluation. In acute crises, gold can perform better than BTC.
phrases.Monitore a razão BTC/Ouro. Se BTC supera: Monitor the BTC/Gold ratio. If BTC consistently outperforms gold, it indicates a preference for risky assets. Gold outperforming BTC suggests defensive environment.
phrases.O West Texas Intermediate (WTI) é o benc: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) is the benchmark for American oil. The price reflects global energy supply/demand and geopolitical tensions.
phrases.Petróleo > $80: Pressão inflacionária. P: Oil > $80: Inflationary pressure. Oil < $60: Possible recession. Sudden spikes usually indicate geopolitical events or OPEC production cuts.
phrases.Petróleo caro = inflação = Fed mais hawk: Expensive oil = inflation = more hawkish Fed = pressure on crypto. Falling oil may indicate recession, but also lower inflationary pressure.
phrases.Eventos na OPEC e tensões no Oriente Méd: Events at OPEC and tensions in the Middle East could cause volatility. Oil affects CPI, so monitor inflation data beforehand.

phrases.O relatório de empregos mais importante: The most important US jobs report. It shows how many jobs were created in the non-agricultural sector. Higher-than-expected numbers could strengthen the dollar and put pressure on stocks, while weak numbers could raise expectations for interest cuts.
phrases.Mercado espera cerca de 160-180K novos e: Market expects around 160-180K new jobs. Also pay attention to the unemployment rate and wage growth.
phrases.Índice de Preços ao Consumidor (Consumer: Consumer Price Index. It measures inflation through the price variation of a basket of goods and services. It is crucial to the Fed's monetary policy decisions.
phrases.Meta do Fed é 2%. Inflação acima de 3% p: The Fed's target is 2%. Inflation above 3% could reduce expectations of interest cuts. Core CPI (excluding food and energy) is even more closely watched.
phrases.Variação mensal do CPI. Mede a inflação: CPI monthly variation. Measures inflation month by month. Higher-than-expected values ​​indicate inflationary pressure.
phrases.Variações mensais acima de 0.3% são preo: Monthly variations above 0.3% are worrying for the Fed.
phrases.CPI sem alimentos e energia (mais voláte: CPI without food and energy (more volatile). It is the inflation indicator most watched by the Fed because it is less subject to temporary shocks.
phrases.Core CPI persistentemente acima de 3% a/: Core CPI persistently above 3% y/y may postpone interest cuts.
phrases.Reunião do FOMC (Comitê Federal de Merca: Meeting of the FOMC (Federal Open Market Committee). The Fed decides the US base interest rate. In addition to the decision, the president's statement and press conference are very important to understand the future direction.
phrases.Observe o \"dot plot\" (projeções dos me: Note the "dot plot" (member projections) and any changes in the tone of the statement. Words like "patient" or "vigilant" impact markets.
phrases.Reunião do FOMC (Comitê Federal de Merca: Meeting of the FOMC (Federal Open Market Committee). The Fed decides the US base interest rate.
phrases.Observe o \"dot plot\" (projeções dos me: Note the "dot plot" (member projections) and any changes in the tone of the statement.
phrases.Personal Consumption Expenditures - o in: Personal Consumption Expenditures - the Federal Reserve's PREFERRED inflation indicator. Broader than CPI and considered more accurate. Core PCE (excluding food and energy) is the Fed's most closely watched metric.
phrases.Meta do Fed é 2%. Core PCE é o principal: The Fed's target is 2%. Core PCE is the main barometer for monetary policy decisions. Values ​​persistently above 2.5% may postpone interest cuts.
phrases.Core PCE exclui alimentos e energia. É o: Core PCE excludes food and energy. It is the Fed's preferred indicator for measuring underlying inflation.
phrases.Meta do Fed é 2%. Valores acima indicam: The Fed's target is 2%. Values ​​above indicate persistent inflation.
phrases.Produto Interno Bruto - a medida mais am: Gross Domestic Product - the broadest measure of economic activity. Published quarterly with reviews. Healthy growth is generally between 2-3% per year.
phrases.GDP forte demais pode pressionar inflaçã: Too strong GDP can pressure inflation. Weak GDP could raise interest rate cut expectations. Technical recession = 2 consecutive quarters of decline.
phrases.Primeira leitura do PIB trimestral. Gera: First reading of quarterly GDP. Generally the one that moves the market the most as it is the first estimate available.
phrases.Crescimento abaixo de 1% pode indicar de: Growth below 1% may indicate a slowdown. Above 3% can pressure inflation.
phrases.Pesquisa do Federal Reserve da Filadélfi: Philadelphia Federal Reserve survey of manufacturing activity in the region. A reading above zero indicates expansion, below indicates contraction. It is one of the first regional indicators released every month.
phrases.Valores acima de 0 indicam expansão. Cor: Values above 0 indicate expansion. Strong correlation with ISM National Manufacturing. Sharp drops can bring about a recession.
phrases.Pesquisa do Federal Reserve de Nova York: New York Federal Reserve survey of manufacturing activity in the state. First regional indicator released every month, serving as a preview of national data.
phrases.Valores acima de 0 indicam expansão. É o: Values above 0 indicate expansion. It is the first regional indicator of the month, anticipating trends.
phrases.Percentual da força de trabalho dos EUA: Percentage of the US labor force that is unemployed. Key component of the Fed's dual mandate (full employment + price stability).
phrases.Desemprego abaixo de 4% é considerado pl: Unemployment below 4% is considered full employment. Rapid rise could signal recession.
phrases.Pedidos iniciais de seguro-desemprego da: Initial unemployment claims for the week. High-frequency weekly indicator that shows the health of the job market in near real time.
phrases.Abaixo de 250K indica mercado de trabalh: Below 250K indicates a strong job market. Above 300K may signal weakness.
phrases.Mede o total de vendas no comércio varej: Measures total US retail sales. Consumption represents ~70% of American GDP, making this data crucial.
phrases.Crescimento mensal acima de 0.5% é posit: Monthly growth above 0.5% is positive. Drop may indicate withdrawn consumer.
phrases.Índice de Gerentes de Compras do setor i: Industrial sector Purchasing Managers Index. Above 50 indicates expansion, below indicates contraction. One of the main leading indicators of the economy.
phrases.Acima de 50 = expansão. Abaixo de 50 = c: Above 50 = expansion. Below 50 = contraction. Below 45 historically associated with recession.
phrases.Índice de Gerentes de Compras do setor d: Purchasing Managers Index for the services sector. Since services are ~80% of the American economy, this is extremely important.
phrases.Acima de 50 = expansão. Setor de serviço: Above 50 = expansion. The service sector is the engine of the American economy.
phrases.Índice de Preços ao Produtor. Mede a inf: Producer Price Index. Measure inflation at the factory gate. Pressures on the PPI usually reflect on the CPI 1-2 months later.
phrases.PPI é um indicador antecipado de inflaçã: PPI is an early indicator of consumer inflation. Recurrent increases put pressure on margins.
phrases.Relatório de empregos privados da ADP. D: ADP Private Employment Report. Released 2 days before the official NFP, it serves as a preview of the job market.
It works as a preview of the official payroll. Large divergences between ADP and NFP generate volatility.
phrases.Pesquisa da Conference Board sobre a con: Conference Board survey on consumer confidence. Confident consumers spend more, boosting GDP.
phrases.Acima de 100 é positivo. Quedas acentuad: Above 100 is positive. Sharp drops may anticipate a slowdown in consumption.
phrases.Índice de Sentimento do Consumidor da Un: University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index. Long-standing research that measures consumer expectations.
phrases.Inclui expectativas de inflação muito ob: Includes inflation expectations closely watched by the Fed.
Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey. Shows the number of vacancies open in the USA. The Fed closely monitors the vacancy/unemployment ratio.
phrases.Relação vagas/desempregados acima de 1.5: Vacancies/unemployed ratio above 1.5 indicates a tight market. Fall may signal slowdown.
phrases.Encomendas de bens duráveis (vida útil >: Orders for durable goods (useful life > 3 years). Important indicator of business investment and industrial activity.
phrases.Core (excluindo transporte) é mais obser: Core (excluding transport) is most observed. Consecutive drop may indicate industrial recession.
phrases.Número de novas construções residenciais: Number of new residential constructions started. It reflects the health of the real estate sector, which is important for the economy.
phrases.Sensível a taxas de juros. Queda indica: Sensitive to interest rates. The drop indicates the impact of interest rates on the housing sector.
phrases.Comunicado oficial do FOMC após a decisã: Official statement from FOMC after the interest rate decision. The tone and words used are closely analyzed by the market.
phrases.Palavras-chave: \"data-dependent\", \"re: Keywords: "data-dependent", "restrictive", "accommodate". Changes in the text signal future trends.
phrases.Minuta detalhada da reunião do FOMC, div: Detailed minutes of the FOMC meeting, released 3 weeks later. Reveals internal debates and divergent opinions of members.
phrases.Atenção ao número de membros a favor de: Pay attention to the number of members in favor of cutting vs maintenance and discussions about risks.
phrases.Mede a produção das fábricas, minas e ut: Measures output from U.S. factories, mines and utilities. Important indicator of economic activity in the productive sector.
phrases.Queda consecutiva pode indicar contração: Consecutive drop may indicate industrial contraction.
phrases.Diferença entre exportações e importaçõe: Difference between US exports and imports. Large deficit indicates that the US imports more than it exports.
phrases.Déficits crescentes podem pressionar o d: Growing deficits could put pressure on the dollar. Surplus is rare for the US.
phrases.Dados de emprego dos EUA. O mercado de t: US employment data. The labor market is one of the most important indicators for the Fed.
phrases.Mercado de trabalho forte pode manter ju: Strong job market could keep interest rates high for longer.
phrases.Discurso ou declaração do Presidente. Po: Speech or statement by the President. It could impact markets depending on announcements about tariffs, fiscal policy or regulation.
phrases.Fique atento a menções sobre tarifas com: Keep an eye out for mentions of trade tariffs, taxes or financial sector regulation.
